summary: Iteration 71 — SuperAdmin Refactor + Advisor Network P0 sprint. Backend PATCH for new advisor rich-profile fields (market_specialization, relationship_tags, notes) PASSES end-to-end (verified via pytest with GET-back persistence). FRONTEND TESTING IS BLOCKED by a regression in SuperAdminRoute guard: super_admin users (verified is_super_admin=true on /api/blueprint/me/permissions, role=super_admin) are redirected from /admin, /admin/modules, /admin/advisors/<id>, /superadmin back to /dashboard. AdminLayout, PlatformCapabilitiesPage, AdvisorDetailPage, AdvisorEditDrawer, MoodDualCircleIcon, the new sidebar IA (Orchestrazione/Network/Piattaforma), and the graphite+cyan theme could NOT be runtime-verified because the guarded subtree never mounts.

ui_bugs.component: SuperAdminRoute guard (App.js:161-167) backed by BlueprintContext.jsx loading lifecycle
ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: when user transitions from null → super_admin, BlueprintProvider's useEffect (lines 208-258) does NOT setLoading(true) at the start of the user-branch. So between the !user branch (which set loading=false) and the await of Promise.allSettled, the component renders with user=truthy, bpLoading=false, isSuperAdmin=false (stale initial false). SuperAdminRoute fires <Navigate to="/dashboard"/> before /api/blueprint/me/permissions resolves. Even though the response carries is_super_admin=true (200 OK confirmed via response interception), the redirect already happened. Reproduced 100% in three consecutive sessions; permission endpoint response was 200 with is_super_admin: true, role: super_admin every time.

integration_issues.flow: All SuperAdmin flows (Control Center overview, Platform Capabilities™ grid, Advisor Network admin, Advisor detail edit drawer, TerritorySelector embed, Languages, Audit)
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the SuperAdminRoute redirect bug above — none of the new screens, testids, or theme tokens can be exercised at runtime.

action_items: FIX (highest priority): In /app/frontend/src/contexts/BlueprintContext.jsx, inside the load() useEffect (around line 209), call setLoading(true) at the very start of the function BEFORE the if(!user) check — so that on every user change the guard re-enters Loading state until the new Promise.allSettled completes. This will unblock the SuperAdmin Control Center entirely.

Alternative/additional: have SuperAdminRoute fall back to a permissive check using useAuth().user.role === 'super_admin' (already available synchronously) instead of waiting on bpLoading + isSuperAdmin race.

Code review: /app/frontend/src/App.js line 414 still has <Route path="/superadmin/pages" element={<HomepageBuilderPage />}/> — review request stated 'Pagine architecture deprecated' and /admin/pages was removed, but the /superadmin/pages alias still points to HomepageBuilderPage. Consider removing for consistency.

After the FE fix, re-run runtime checks on: admin-shell data-surface=control-center, MoodDualCircleIcon SVG circles, sidebar groups Orchestrazione/Network/Piattaforma, absence of Pagine + Moduli labels, PLATFORM·SUPER ADMIN chip color = cyan #00C9B3, all 11 pcap-card-* testids, AdvisorEditDrawer 4 sections + save flow, tenant-palette-isolation regression.
critical_code_review_comments: BlueprintContext.jsx load() effect is non-idempotent across user transitions: it should setLoading(true) at the top so consumers can rely on bpLoading flipping back to true when user changes (critical for SuperAdminRoute, TenantTheme, modules permission gating).

rca of the issue: Reproduced: 1) Login as demo@moodfordesign.com 2) wait_for_url('**/dashboard**') 3) page.goto('/admin') 4) Observed: URL stays at /dashboard, admin-shell never mounts. Network panel confirms /api/blueprint/me/permissions returns 200 with {is_super_admin: true, role: 'super_admin'} every time. RCA: SuperAdminRoute (App.js:161) renders <Navigate to='/dashboard'/> when isSuperAdmin === false AND (loading || bpLoading) === false. On user transition (null→super_admin), BlueprintContext.jsx load() effect (line 208) does not reset setLoading(true) at the start of the user branch, so for one render cycle: user truthy, bpLoading=false (residual from the !user branch), isSuperAdmin=false (initial useState false). Navigate fires before Promise.allSettled awaits resolve and setIsSuperAdmin(true) is committed. Mitigation: add `setLoading(true);` as the first line inside the inner async load() (before the if(!user) early return), so every dependency change forces a Loading state until both endpoints (permissions in particular) resolve. Alternative belt-and-suspenders: in SuperAdminRoute, accept user.role === 'super_admin' from useAuth as a synchronous fallback alongside bp.isSuperAdmin.
